verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a Public API, but it is scoped to organization administration (members, collections, groups, event logs, policies). Vault items are reachable programmatically only through the CLI's local `bw serve` RESTful Vault Management API, authenticated with a personal API key. Because the hosted public API covers only part of the product, this is direct support with partial coverage rather than full delivery. missing for 10: a hosted public API covering vault items for individual users (the Public API is organization-admin only and vault access requires running a local CLI server), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
the CLI whose documented `bw serve` mode exposes the whole vault as a local RESTful API (Vault Management API) an agent can query for TOTP codes and items.
Using the personal API key for CLI authentication is suitable for automated workflows
